import numpy as np
def run(w, extra=True):
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    cols=[np.ones_like(t),x,v,C,S]
    if extra: cols+= [x*C,x*S,v*C,v*S,x*x,v*v,x*v]
    A=np.column_stack(cols); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt), c
